title: Best AI Website Builder for Real Estate Agents in 2026
summary: Most general AI website builders don't touch the one thing that actually generates leads for an agent: IDX. We scored eight tools on IDX readiness, lead capture, and mobile speed, not just design.
body_markdown: For an agent whose business runs on internet lead generation specifically, Real Geeks' native IDX and built-in CRM are hard to match. For an agent who wants a strong brand site with real lead capture and the flexibility to add IDX later, Blink is the strongest general-purpose choice, with a real database and CRM-ready lead routing built in.
